record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare STICKY_WEB: Dewpider (1 star) and Araquanid (2 stars), both maxPP 100, range 1, passive WATER_BUBBLE. Units are bound by the queue record only. The passive is a separate identifier and is not covered here.

dispatch.routingNote: NAME_SHARED_WITH_EFFECT: STICKY_WEB is both an Ability (registry strategy above) and an EffectEnum / board effect of the same name. Both are used by this ability: the strategy places EffectEnum.STICKY_WEB on cells, and the effect's only consumer found is status.ts updateAllStatus (paralysis).

record.summary: Single-target special damage plus a sticky-web board effect. The caster deals SPECIAL damage 20/35/70/140 (by the caster's stars; AP-scaled, crit only with ABILITY_CRIT) to its target, then marks the up-to-three on-board cells adjacent to the caster in the direction of the target (the facing cell and its two neighbours, range 1) with the STICKY_WEB board effect. The board effect is a property of the cell with no team check: any unit standing on such a cell (the target, other enemies, or the caster's own allies) is given the STICKY_WEB effect (unless it holds Heavy Duty Boots), and updateAllStatus then paralyses a unit that has the effect for 2000 ms whenever it is not already paralysed (Heavy Duty Boots, Rune Protect and IMMUNITY_PARALYSIS block it; storm weather and duration reductions change the duration). A unit that walks onto a marked cell gains the effect (unless IMMUNITY_BOARD_EFFECTS) and loses it on leaving. The strategy has no timer for the cell effect; only clearing code elsewhere (not enumerated) removes it.

targeting.who: damage: the cast target (requiresTarget stays true, so the unit walks to range first); web: the cells adjacent to the caster in the target's direction, regardless of who stands on them
targeting.note: The target parameter is typed non-null. Damage is dealt before the cells are computed; getCellsInFront reads the target's position after damage and sets the caster's orientation as a side effect.

geometry.shape: the caster's three cells in front: orientation toward the target plus the next and previous orientation in OrientationArray, one step each (range 1), dropped when off the board; empty and occupied cells are both returned

effects.scaling: requested = table value indexed by the caster's stars (fallback 140). downstream request to handleDamage = requested x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true), x2 if the caster has DOUBLE_DAMAGE (consumed), x1.2 with the strange-steam board effect, x (1 + (critPower - 1) x critReductionFactor) only when the cast crit flag is true (the cast crits only with ABILITY_CRIT, since canCritByDefault is false; Rocky Helmet on the target cancels it). handleDamage then applies the target's SPE_DEF (damage / (1 + 0.05 x speDef), half defenses under armor reduction), flat reductions, ceil and the floor of 1 (core-mechanics section A), and shields absorb first. The value returned as takenDamage (shield part included) is discarded by this strategy. Protect, skydiving or magic bounce on the target return takenDamage 0 before any damage (a magic bounce can reflect damage back); a Power Lens holding target retaliates against the caster.
effects.resolution: requested 20 (Dewpider) / 35 (Araquanid) -> downstream request after AP/crit -> final HP loss after SPE_DEF, shield, Fossil/Shiny Charm/Cover Band exceptions (section J1); the strategy does not use takenDamage, so none of those exceptions change anything else in this ability.

effects.target: each on-board cell in front of the caster
effects.scaling: no amount; the effect is a flag in Board.boardEffects. Entities currently on the cell get the flag in entity.effects unless they hold Heavy Duty Boots; the cell keeps the flag (added once; the client animation is broadcast only the first time).
effects.resolution: cell flagged -> entity on or entering the cell gains EffectEnum.STICKY_WEB (entering needs no IMMUNITY_BOARD_EFFECTS; the immediate placement on an occupied cell only checks Heavy Duty Boots) -> status.ts applies paralysis (see statusEffects)

statusEffects.duration: 2000 ms requested (triggerParalysis(2000, pokemon, null), origin null so no AP boost), re-triggered each update while the unit has the effect and is not already paralysed
statusEffects.guards: Heavy Duty Boots (checked at placement and again in updateAllStatus), status.runeProtect, IMMUNITY_PARALYSIS; the duration is x1.3 in STORM weather (less with Electric Quartz on the unit's player) and then passes applyStatusDurationReductions; a longer cooldown wins; a Cheri Berry holder eats it

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 3- and 4-star values are not reachable at the factory star counts of these units. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined. The web and paralysis do not depend on stars.

record.positionalConditions: The web cells depend on the caster's position and on the direction to the target at the moment of the cast; cells outside the board are dropped. Whether a unit is paralysed depends on whether it stands on a marked cell (not on its team or on being the target).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: Each cast sets the same flag on the same or other cells; a cell already holding the effect is not re-flagged or re-announced, so repeated casts only extend the marked area. No stored mode. The cell effect has no expiry in this file.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: SPECIAL 20/35 (1/2 stars). Downstream: x(1+AP/100), crit only with ABILITY_CRIT, then SPE_DEF reduction, ceil, floor 1 and shield absorption inside handleDamage; takenDamage is unused. Paralysis: requested 2000 ms, applied through storm weather and duration reductions and blocked by Heavy Duty Boots, Rune Protect (not Protect) or IMMUNITY_PARALYSIS. The slow or accuracy effect of paralysis was not traced.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: What paralysis does to a unit (movement/attack speed, see core-mechanics section C) was not traced for this record
The full handleDamage chain (section A lists the defense step only); weather, fields, resurrect and death rules were not traced
Which other code clears or ignores a board effect (Ice Spinner and Waterfall call clearBoardEffect; Tidal Wave in the simulation clears all) was not enumerated
